name: message-queue
description: Keep messages in a to-do style queue and choose when each one is sent to Claude

autoSend.title: Auto-send
autoSend.description: When Claude finishes answering, send the next queued message by itself. Off: nothing is sent until you send it.

captureWaitSubmit.title: Queue on ctrl+x enter
captureWaitSubmit.description: ctrl+x enter (the wait-your-turn submit) puts the draft in the queue instead of sending it.

showBand.title: Show count above the prompt
showBand.description: A line above the prompt with the number of queued messages and the next one, while the queue is not empty.
